title: Niadra Turn Record v0
description: What an AI agent read, called, showed, claimed and decided in one turn, with its build pinned. See spec/turn-record.md.

Attribute.description: What the person is: a size, a preferred network, a diet. Said here; the lifecycle's outcomes (bought, kept, returned for size) derive the rest on the server, never an agent.
Attribute.title: Attribute

ClaimEvidenceRef.description: Where a claim's evidence is in the turn record: a call's field, an object's field, or a document.

anchor.description: The blob that keeps the quoted text.
anchor.title: Anchor

ClaimEvidenceRef.title: ClaimEvidenceRef

ClaimRecord.description: One claim the SDK found in an output, as the turn record carries it: kinds, spans and verdicts.

span.description: Code point offsets of the claim in the output, end exclusive.
span.title: Span

action.description: What was done, which the contract's configured action decides: `rewrite_if_unequivocal` is `rewrite` when the rewrite is unequivocal and `warn` otherwise, `discard_anchor_and_count` is `discard_anchor`, and a claim that stands (`matched`, `quoted_found`, `anchored`) is `none`.
action.title: Action

ClaimRecord.title: ClaimRecord

ClaimValue.description: A number the parser read, normalized: an amount, or a range from `min` to `max`, with its unit (the currency code of money, `%`, a time unit, a unit of measure or of dose), or a date, or a range of dates.
ClaimValue.title: ClaimValue

exposure_id.description: Absent for an item of no list.
exposure_id.title: Exposure Id

Preference.description: What the person wants or refuses, said or captured from a tool's arguments; only these become hard.

category.description: Holds only in this category of the type.
category.title: Category

Preference.title: Preference

Presented.description: A list delivered to the person: the exposure. Its canonical moment is `delivered_at`, when the interface bridge handed the list to the client, never when a tool returned it or the model named it.

page.description: "See more" is the same list with `page + 1`.
page.title: Page

visible_k.description: How many of the first items were visible on delivery.
visible_k.title: Visible K

method.description: `bridge` from the interface bridge, `otel` from a `niadra.exposure` span, `tool_result` inferred from what a tool returned: labeled, because it counts more than was shown.
method.title: Method

Presented.title: Presented

pos.description: 1-based position in the whole list, across pages.
pos.title: Pos

shown.description: The values the item showed, for the fields its type tracks or lets be claimed; what `changes_since_seen` later compares against.
shown.title: Shown

team.description: Which of two interleaved lists contributed the item.
team.title: Team

Seen.description: A ping of the list component: how far the person saw.
Seen.title: Seen

name.description: The agent's name inside the source, e.g. `closing`.
name.title: Name

parent_turn_id.description: The turn that opened this one as a sub-turn (a sub-agent, an agent as tool).
parent_turn_id.title: Parent Turn Id

TurnBlob.description: A large value of the record. `sha256` is over its normalized canonical JSON (RFC 8785): the same value always has the same hash.

pointer.description: Where the customer keeps it, in `pointer` mode.
pointer.title: Pointer

content.description: The value itself, only in `stored` mode.
content.title: Content

TurnBlob.title: TurnBlob

adapter.description: The framework adapter and its version, if any.
adapter.title: Adapter

TurnCall.description: One tool or model call of the turn, copied deep at the moment it happened.

name.description: The tool's name, or the model's for a model call.
name.title: Name

anyOf.description: A blob of this record, by its key in `blobs`, e.g. `b:1`.
A blob of this record, by its key in `blobs`, e.g. `b:1`.

result_model.description: The result as the model saw it.
result_model.title: Result Model

anyOf.description: A blob of this record, by its key in `blobs`, e.g. `b:1`.

result_ui.description: The result as the interface got it.
result_ui.title: Result Ui

TurnCall.title: TurnCall

compiler.description: The context compiler's version, from the pack.
compiler.title: Compiler

pack_hash.description: The hash of the pack this turn read.
pack_hash.title: Pack Hash

TurnConstraints.description: What the SDK measured of the constraints block on one tool call: sent, checked, violated.

constraints.description: The version of the constraints block applied.
constraints.title: Constraints

TurnConstraints.title: TurnConstraints

TurnObservation.description: State a tool result showed, with provenance per field; without provenance it is display only.
TurnObservation.title: TurnObservation

event_keys.description: The events `track()` sent for what the turn said: the text is never repeated here.
event_keys.title: Event Keys

anyOf.description: A blob of this record, by its key in `blobs`, e.g. `b:1`.
A blob of this record, by its key in `blobs`, e.g. `b:1`.

document.description: A document the turn wrote, by its blob.
document.title: Document

TurnPins.description: What must be the same for a replay to reproduce this turn. The recording document says which are required; a turn without one of them is kept, marked not replayable.

corpus_digest.description: Digest of the files the agent consults, computed in the SDK; never the files.
corpus_digest.title: Corpus Digest

model.description: The exact model the agent called.
model.title: Model

assembler.description: The version of the company's context assembler.
assembler.title: Assembler

tool_schemas.description: Tool name -> hash of its schema.
tool_schemas.title: Tool Schemas

TurnPins.title: TurnPins

TurnRead.description: A read the turn made from Niadra, by its version: the pack by ETag, a block by its version.

anyOf.description: A blob of this record, by its key in `blobs`, e.g. `b:1`.

blob.description: The content read, when the recording keeps it.
blob.title: Blob

TurnRead.title: TurnRead

Watch.description: An explicit "let me know when": the only way an interest raises a notice.

condition.description: A `niadra-expr` expression over the object's fields.
condition.title: Condition

Watch.title: Watch

propertyNames.description: A blob of this record, by its key in `blobs`, e.g. `b:1`.
